data.name: WarningText
data.value: Local is the safest default: the server is only reachable from its own machine, and pairing a new device is impossible from anywhere else. Each wider tier is a deliberate choice - the app never widens its own exposure on its own. Changing this setting takes effect only after the server is restarted (Kestrel's listen addresses are fixed at startup).

data.name: RemoteAccessHelpText
data.value: A tunnel only changes network transport - it does not replace passkey pairing/sign-in. An unauthenticated request arriving over the tunnel still cannot reach any data. Starting a tunnel makes this server reachable from the internet, so it requires a fresh passkey confirmation (step-up) even in an already-signed-in session.

data.value: Select the Internet tier above to manage remote access tunnels.

data.name: QuickTunnelDescription
data.value: Starts an ephemeral *.trycloudflare.com URL - no Cloudflare account needed. Good for short-term remote access; the URL changes every time you start a new one.

data.name: NamedTunnelDescription
data.value: Runs a persistent tunnel you already configured at the command line (cloudflared tunnel login, cloudflared tunnel create <name>, and a DNS route) - that one-time setup is not automated here. Select an already-configured tunnel to run it.
